$comment: Boilerworks ecosystem terms. Federated into app/brain.json by scripts/gen-brain.py (glossary adapter).

terms.definition: A production-ready starter repo (ConflictHQ/boilerworks-*) the CLI clones and renders into a new project. The catalogue of selectable templates lives in boilerworks/data/templates.yaml; each is pinned as a submodule under templates/.
A template's weight class: full (complete application platform with user auth and Docker Compose), micro (lightweight API-key service), or edge (Cloudflare-first, serverless).
How a generated project's repos are arranged: standard (one app repo + optional ops repo), omni (everything in one repo), or api-only (backend without the frontend).

The per-stack conventions document (primers/<template>/PRIMER.md) teaching an agent or developer the stack, architecture, and standards of one template. Root primers (PROCESS.md, CATALOGUE.md) hold the cross-stack process and catalogue rationale.

A repo that folds a family of repos in as pinned git submodules to give one control surface — bootstrap, sync, status, and push-ordering across the whole set. This repo is the boilerworks metarepo (templates/ holds the submodules).

A repo that compiles its structured sources (app/*.json) into a queryable property graph at app/brain.json via scripts/gen-brain.py. A parent aggregator federates the node at a pinned SHA, namespacing its ids.

app/knowledge_graph.json — the conflict-kg/v1 projection of the template catalogue (templates, languages, size classes and their relations), generated from templates.yaml by scripts/gen-template-kg.py.
